summary: The Battle for Wesnoth is an open-source, turn-based tactical strategy game set in a high fantasy universe. It supports both single-player campaigns and multiplayer matches via hotseat or online play.
goodFor: Self-hosters and gaming communities looking to run an established tactical strategy game for multiplayer sessions on their own infrastructure.
watchOut: Multiplayer hosting may require network configuration such as port forwarding, and you should ensure your server environment meets the runtime requirements for C++ applications packaged as Debian binaries.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves managing standard package dependencies and ensuring persistent storage is available for game states and server configurations if hosting a dedicated multiplayer instance.
